Marta (People Ops): Heads up  Rita is day-1 tomorrow. Shes on a temporary visa; vendor flagged E-Verify needed + I-9 docs. Need a plan for badge & laptop pickup 9:00-10:00.
Ibrahim (Facilities): I can meet at lobby 8:50 and handle escort + temp badge. Please send plate info for parking.
Chen (IT): Laptop will be at front desk by 8:30, tag: VISA-APR26. Well attach a sticker with Wi-Fi creds and buddy contact. Full provisioning after I-9 + E-Verify clearance.
Rita (New Hire): I uploaded my passport, I-94, and EAD scan to the portal. Vendor asked for E-Verify consent; I clicked the consent link this morning.
E-Verify-Bot: NOTE: Candidate Rita has submitted E-Verify consent. Employer action required to run E-Verify within 3 business days. Link to run: https://admin.redwood/everify.
Marta (People Ops): Compliance, can we issue a temp badge once Facilities confirms ID in person while E-Verify runs?
Compliance-Kate: Yes. For visa holders, complete Form I-9 with presented documents (List A). You may issue a temporary badge and limited access while E-Verify pending. Ensure copies uploaded to secure folder and log reviewer name.
Ibrahim (Facilities): Parking pass request submitted for Lot C. Badge envelope will be printed and left at front desk.
Chen (IT): Temp account: rita.temp@redwood.test. Network access only. Manager to request escalations after clearance.
Marta (People Ops): Benefits intro at 11:00 via Zoom. Rita, join remotely if anything delays. Also approving $40 for light breakfast. Ibrahim, pickup at 8:00?
Ibrahim (Facilities): Yep, will grab breakfast at 8:00.
Rita (New Hire): Thanks everyone. Il bring originals to the lobby and will be there at 8:50.
Marta (People Ops): Action items: (1) Ibrahim escort + badge (2) Chen confirm laptop staged (3) Compliance to check uploads & run E-Verify (4) Marta to add Rita to benefits Zoom. Ping me if any issues. :thumbsup:
